record.field:
Execute a natural-language development task using Claude Code (claude-agent-sdk). Claude autonomously reads files, runs bash commands, edits code, and searches the codebase inside the container.
Pass a clear, detailed prompt describing the task. Claude will work in the configured work folder (/workspace/ordomatics/addons/odoo-llm) and return a full report of what it did.
Examples: - "List all Python files in the llm_skills module" - "Find all TODO comments in the llm_mcp_server module and summarise them" - "Run the test suite for llm_tool and report failures"
